name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 3 visits over 15 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 18 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 15 hours starting 2026-04-20, at wavelengths from 1.09 to 4.93 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
